propositions: Whole-tree build-provenance fixtures export 3,019 checkout files but production hatch_build.py consumes only hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, and src/rebar/__init__.py, causing repeated full-package builds across xdist workers.

Live artifact-probe run 31874837464 built wheel and sdist with trusted-main GITHUB_SHA 7d908fb instead of patchset SHA 9aecb53e, violating exact-source identity despite truthiness-only assertions passing.

Real isolated PEP 517 sdist-to-wheel builds through production hook on minimal committed Hatch fixture preserve fallback SHA, env override, blank-env failure, and shallow-source behavior while reducing paired build times from 6.30/9.26s to 2.66/5.43s.
Both _artifact-probe.yml workflow lanes must derive expected SHA using git rev-parse --short HEAD after final checkout and assert exact equality for wheel and installed sdist, not truthiness.
No hook-semantics test must retain _clean_tree, _self_contained_checkout, or inline git-archive materialization; string sweep must confirm no other full-checkout archive exists in fixtures.
